service_version.description: Version string of the telephony service (auto-assigned at install).

logging.level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error.

logging.file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stdout only.

network.bind_address.description: IP address to bind SIP/RTP services to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '127.0.0.1').

network.sip_port.description: SIP signaling port (typically 5060 or 5061 for TLS).

network.rtp_port_min.description: Lowest port in the RTP media port range.

network.rtp_port_max.description: Highest port in the RTP media port range (must be ≥ min).

sip.outbound_proxy.description: SIP outbound proxy URI (e.g., 'sip:proxy.example.com:5060'). Empty = use user_identity domain.

sip.user_identity.description: SIP user identity (e.g., '1000@example.com'). Required for registration.

sip.auth.password.description: Password for SIP authentication. Leave blank for certificate-only auth.

sip.ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification.

sip.client_cert_path.description: Optional: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS.

sip.client_key_path.description: Optional: Path to client private key for mutual TLS.

calling.max_calls.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active calls.

calling.codecs.description: Ordered list of audio codecs (preferred first). Supported: opus, g722, pcma, pcmu, g711, ilbc.

pstn_gateways.description: List of PSTN gateway definitions (optional). Each entry defines a trunk to a PSTN provider.

name.description: Human-readable name for the PSTN gateway.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the PSTN gateway (SIP proxy or trunk server).

port.description: Port (typically 5060 for SIP or 5061 for SIPS).

trunk_id.description: Trunk identifier used in SIP From/Contact headers.

devices.description: List of telephony hardware devices (e.g., sound cards, Bluetooth profiles). Each device configures its own audio interface.

id.description: Unique identifier for the device (e.g., 'hw:0' for ALSA card 0).

config.description: Key-value map of device-specific settings (e.g., 'device: hw:0', 'channels: 1').

socket_activation.description: Enable systemd socket activation (recommended for on-demand startup).
